instruction: Take the form.docx file on the desktop and create a PDF version, then upload it to the forms folder in Google Drive.

args.query: title = 'form.pdf' or title = 'form.docx' or title = 'form.docx.pdf' or title = 'forms'

metadata.explanation: Rephrased instruction using 'create a PDF version'. Evaluator verifies PDF file in forms folder has 1 page.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction has 2 steps (convert docx to PDF + upload to Drive), but evaluator only verifies step 2 (upload)
Cannot verify conversion: Evaluator only checks if a PDF exists in forms folder, but cannot verify it was actually converted from form.docx
No source verification: Evaluator would pass even if a different PDF was manually uploaded without touching form.docx
Weak content verification: Only checks file size > 10KB, doesn't verify PDF content matches docx content
Missing assumption documentation: Page count check assumes form.docx has exactly 1 page, but this isn't verified or documented
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification that form.docx was actually used as source (e.g., compare PDF content with docx content, or check PDF metadata for conversion source)
Either simplify instruction to only require upload (remove conversion requirement) OR add evaluator steps to verify conversion happened
Add more robust content verification beyond just file size (e.g., check PDF has extractable text, verify page count matches source)
Document the assumption that form.docx has 1 page in metadata, or make the expected page count dynamic based on source file analysis
